description: This PHP class 'AOPAssignManager' manages assignment logic for cases in SuiteCRM, including user distribution methods like round robin, least busy, single user, and random. It handles user retrieval, fallback mechanisms, and session management for user assignment.

classes.name: AOPAssignManager
classes.description: Manages case assignment strategies such as round robin, least busy, single user, and random within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the assignment manager with optional inbound email object and determines distribution method.

methods.name: isAOPFallback
methods.description: Checks if the current distribution method should fallback to default.

methods.name: getDistributionOptions
methods.description: Retrieves distribution options based on fallback status.

methods.name: getRoleUsers
methods.description: Retrieves users linked to a specific role.

methods.name: getAssignableUsers
methods.description: Determines the list of users available for assignment based on distribution options.

methods.name: getSingleUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user ID for single user distribution.

methods.name: getLeastBusyCounts
methods.description: Calculates the number of cases assigned to each user to identify least busy users.

methods.name: getLeastBusyUser
methods.description: Selects the user with the fewest assigned cases.

methods.name: updateLeastBusy
methods.description: Updates the count of cases for a user after assignment.

methods.name: getRandomUser
methods.description: Selects a random user from the assignable users.

methods.name: getNextAssignedUser
methods.description: Determines the next user to assign a case based on the distribution method.

methods.name: getRoundRobinUser
methods.description: Selects the next user in round robin order.

methods.name: setLastRoundRobinUser
methods.description: Stores the last user in round robin sequence in session and cache.
